notes: Exact Film Red illustrated outfits. No Gear 5, Asura, Ifrit Jambe, Demonio Fleur or other transformation inferred from clothing.

luffy-film-red.scope: Monkey D. Luffy — Film Red illustrated costume
luffy-film-red.basis: Rubber-body combat and Haki are known within the continuity; this illustrated outfit alone does not depict an active Gear.
luffy-film-red.limits: Film Red pirate costume is not proof of Gear 4 or Gear 5.

zoro-film-red.scope: Roronoa Zoro — Film Red illustrated costume
zoro-film-red.basis: Highly skilled three-sword combatant with Haki and hard-won battle experience.
zoro-film-red.limits: Do not label this ordinary Film Red costume as King of Hell or Asura.

nami-film-red.basis: Weather-based staff techniques and sharp tactical thinking.
nami-film-red.limits: No Zeus-based finisher is visible in this pose; avoid treating outfit as activated ability.

usopp-film-red.basis: Expert ranged trick shots, utility ammunition and survival under pressure.
usopp-film-red.limits: No unrestricted Haki mastery or giant-scale offence.

sanji-film-red.basis: Elite close-quarters kicks, mobility and fire-based techniques.
sanji-film-red.limits: This costume is not an illustration of an active Ifrit Jambe strike.

chopper-film-red.scope: Tony Tony Chopper — Film Red illustrated costume
chopper-film-red.basis: Zoan transformations and medical expertise underpin situational fighting.
chopper-film-red.limits: Small base appearance does not depict Monster Point.

robin-film-red.scope: Nico Robin — Film Red illustrated costume
robin-film-red.basis: Hana Hana no Mi limb projection and grappling provide effective close combat.
robin-film-red.limits: This image is not Demonio Fleur; no transformation is inferred.

franky-film-red.basis: Cyborg strength, built-in weaponry and resilience offer broad offence.
franky-film-red.limits: The outfit is not automatically General Franky or a special cannon deployment.

brook-film-red.basis: Fast swordplay, music and soul-based utility plus cold techniques.
brook-film-red.limits: Do not assume a special soul-projection transformation from the costume.

jinbe-film-red.basis: Mastery of Fish-Man Karate and Haki, with high durability.
jinbe-film-red.limits: Water availability and terrain can change his strongest tactics.

shanks-film-red.basis: An Emperor renowned for extreme Haki mastery and formidable sword combat.
shanks-film-red.limits: Do not interpret status alone as evidence for SS, SSS, EX or limitless attacks.
